sentences.text: 1 Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel has raised a preliminary objection that the petitioners can make a reference under Section 64 of the aforesaid Act.
In view thereof, the writ petition is consigned to record with liberty to the petitioners to make a reference under Section 64 of the Act, 2013.
In case such a reference is made, the same shall be decided by the authority concerned in accordance with law expeditiously.
